other_failure_modes.name: Encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical frequency encoding is applied to the combined train and test dataset before splitting, which leaks the statistical distribution of categories in the test set into the training features.

summary: The agent's solution builds a solid foundation with LightGBM and CatBoost models, incorporating useful feature engineering and an optimized ensembling approach. However, it suffers from critical data leakage by performing median imputation and frequency encoding on the combined train and test datasets prior to splitting. Furthermore, the random K-Fold cross-validation ignores the temporal nature of the dataset, risking look-ahead bias and overly optimistic evaluation scores.
